title: Cengiz, Dube, Lindner, Zipperer (2019), The Effect of Minimum Wages on Low-Wage Jobs, QJE 134(3)
summary: Bunching estimator over 138 state MW changes 1979-2016: total low-wage jobs essentially unchanged 5 years post-increase; no disemployment even at higher MW levels; some reduced employment in tradable sectors; lack of job loss not from labor-labor substitution.
